text:
liam: Heads up — I'm sketching a new Grafana dashboard to help triage flaky GPU cards. Goal: correlate ECC/Xid spikes with node drains and replacement ops across regions so we reduce noisy pages and make replace/drain decisions data-driven. thoughts?

maya: love it. we need region rollups + device_serial tagging. also a 'last drain reason' label on nodes.

andre: agree. metrics I'd use: gpu_ecc_errors_total and gpu_xid_errors_total (increase over window), node_drain_count, and kernel_oops_count. join by device_serial and region.

sophia: can you paste the PromQL you had in mind? also add mapping to inventory id so hardware team can batch replacements.

liam: sure — rough PromQL samples below. main idea is error rate per device over 1h + recent drains.

```promql
# ECC error rate per device in percent over last 1h
100 * sum by(region, device_serial) (increase(gpu_ecc_errors_total[1h]))
  / sum by(region, device_serial) (increase(gpu_ecc_checks_total[1h]))
\n# XID errors per device over 24h
sum by(region, device_serial) (increase(gpu_xid_errors_total[24h]))
\n# Recent drains for the node (24h)
sum by(region, device_serial) (increase(node_drain_count[24h]))
```
\nliam: Example alert rule: trigger if ECC rate > 5% AND drains >= 1 in last 24h OR XID > 10 in 24h. For dashboard we show trend + last drain reason and last nvml diag result.

chris: For actionability we need a health_score. propose weighted sum: ECC_rate(normalized) * 0.4 + XID_rate * 0.3 + telemetry_disconnects * 0.2 + recent_drains_score * 0.1 -> scale 0-100. thresholds: <30 => Replace, 30-60 => Schedule maintenance, >60 => Healthy.

maya: also add cost panel: estimated replacement cost vs lost throughput (tokens/sec * avg_cost) so PMs can justify immediate replace vs keep throttling.

infra-bot: dashboard:update staging/gpu-flaky-triage — panels added: ecc_rate, xid_count, drain_events, health_score, replacement_cost_estimate :gear:

sophia: :eyes: can we make a region-level SLO: 99.9% of time region aggregate health_score >= 60? If violated, open reliability ticket with paging.

liam: yes. propose SLO defined as: fraction of time sum(weighted healthy capacity)/sum(total capacity) >= 0.6 across pool. Burn-rate alerts on 10m and 1h windows.

andre: runbook draft to pin in dashboard notes: 1) cordon node; 2) run nvml diag & kernel logs; 3) attach device_serial -> inventory; 4) if health_score < 30 and ECC_rate > threshold -> auto-replace (but see cadence exceptions).

maya: please avoid auto-replace in single-AZ low-capacity pools. fallback behavior: throttle routing + route to cheaper model variant or lower batch size to keep latency SLOs.

chris: I'll own building the Grafana panels + PromQL translation for alerts. liam you ok to own health_score calc and RFC?

liam: yes — I'll open RFC and bake in sample queries, alert thresholds, and a small simulation script to validate thresholds against last 90d.

deploy-bot: alertrule:create staging "gpu_card_flaky_threshold" (prometheus-rule) — pending review

liam: thanks. next steps: chris add panels to staging folder, I will run thresholds against historical data and post summary here. if we hit consensus we promote alerts to prod and add SLO in console.

maya: thanks everyone. one last ask — add a small panel showing replacer lead time (procurement ETA) and replacement backlog so infra ops can plan.

liam: good call. I'll include procurement ETA and estimated downtime cost. tagging infra ops to review once RFC is up. :thumbsup:

chris: picking this up now. will ping when panels are ready in staging.

infra-bot: note: saved dashboard draft: https://grafana.example.com/d/abc123/gpu-flaky-triage (staging)

sophia: awesome, thanks.

liam: closing thread — follow-up RFC link will be here when ready.
